scientific_integrity: Theorem proved for all positive part sizes and all equivalence-block sizes >=2; direct finite enumeration is corroboration, not infinite proof. The antecedent supplies underlying E-compatible tolerance semantics; no independence or external originality certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to reflexive complete bipartite quotient tolerance only.
All equivalence blocks must have at least two points.
Rank variables count equivalence blocks, not individual elements.
Input-subset multiplicities and block sizes are not reconstructed.
Priority of the exact formula has not been independently audited.
title: Bimodal rough-approximation spectra reconstruct complete bipartite tolerance quotients
